question: How tall is the preset strip in the editor panel, in points?
probes: Run the original on a device and measure the Presets panel
Find the frame height where the panel hosts PresetsView
resolution: In preset mode the panel's height is 0.2 of the measured editor height, kept between 150 and 250 (0x1001aaab4, constant 0x1011a7bf8), unless a cached height above zero replaces it (0x1001aad58). The panel has 16 of padding on top and at the sides: pad is 8 (0x1001bd9f4), doubled at 0x1001b7608. The tile is square, so its side is what remains after the padding, title and the 20 under the strip.
